NO_SALE.later_comparison: After=replay an attained maximum-gross-purchase signed asset schedule on every original path; before=the full selected model policy. Other assets retain every original trade; no branches or probability mass are dropped.

snapshot: Sealed2026-11-17 model prices and forecast laws; market data are not refreshed by this sensitivity calculation
missing_value_rule: Undefined ratios and cash/holding-infeasible counterfactuals are unavailable, never zero
